item.title: LIVE: Ocean's Most One-Sided Fights | Orca vs Great White & More
item.description:
Made with Restream Studio. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io
LIVE: the ocean's most lopsided confrontations, starting with orca vs great white shark — the one matchup where the "apex predator" title doesn't actually belong to the shark.
Join this stream as we go through real footage of orcas hunting great white sharks, break down why mudskippers survive encounters that should kill them, and look at a handful of other one-sided ocean fights most people have never seen footage of.
This connects to our full breakdowns here: [https://youtu.be/7k5HB2LQVBA] and [https://youtu.be/1TFrk11qwmQ] — watch those next for the complete science behind tonight's footage.
Nature Frontiers brings you real wildlife science — no cartoons, no filler, just the natural world at its most extreme. Subscribe for new apex predator breakdowns every week.
